name: tia_retrieve_project
description: Retrieve a compressed project archive (.zap21) into an empty folder and open it in the attached TIA Portal instance (Projects.Retrieve). An open project is closed only with close_current=true and only when it has no unsaved changes.

target_directory.description: Empty or non-existing folder to retrieve into.

close_current.description: Close the project currently open in this instance first (default: false).
